attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Mouseover Kick
macros.desc: Interrupt the caster under your cursor, or your current target when the cursor is on nothing.
macros.needs: Kick learned (level 12)

macros.title: Mouseover Sap
macros.desc: Sap the enemy under your cursor and keep your main target selected.
macros.needs: Sap learned (level 10); a Humanoid that isn't in combat. Classic also wanted Stealth. The tooltip doesn't ask for it, but we haven't tested that in play

macros.title: Stealth that won't switch itself off
macros.desc: Dismount if you need to and slip into Stealth; pressing it again while hidden does nothing instead of dropping you out.
macros.needs: Out of combat; Stealth has a 10 second cooldown

macros.title: Mouseover Pick Pocket
macros.desc: Pick the pocket of the enemy under your cursor, or your target when the cursor is on nothing.
macros.needs: Pick Pocket learned; Stealth and a Humanoid within melee range, as in Classic

macros.title: Pick Pocket, then open from Stealth
macros.desc: One key for the whole opener: it enters Stealth if you're visible, then Pick Pocket and Cheap Shot on your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth,mod:shift] Garrote; [stealth,mod:ctrl] Ambush; Cheap Shot
/cast [stealth] Pick Pocket
/cast [nostealth] Stealth; [mod:shift] Garrote; [mod:ctrl] Ambush; Cheap Shot

keys.text: Stealth if you're visible, otherwise Pick Pocket and Cheap Shot
Pick Pocket and Garrote instead of Cheap Shot
Pick Pocket and Ambush instead of Cheap Shot

macros.needs: Cheap Shot learned (level 26); a dagger in your main hand for Ambush; behind your target for Garrote and Ambush
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth,mod:shift] Garrote; [stealth,mod:ctrl] Emboscar; Golpe Baixo
/cast [stealth] Bater Carteira
/cast [nostealth] Furtividade; [mod:shift] Garrote; [mod:ctrl] Emboscar; Golpe Baixo

macros.title: Evasion and Sprint together
macros.desc: Press once in a bad fight to raise your dodge and pick up speed at the same time.
macros.needs: Evasion (level 8) and Sprint (level 10) off cooldown; neither uses the global cooldown

macros.title: Use both trinkets
macros.desc: Fire the trinkets in both trinket slots with one press.
macros.needs: On-use trinkets equipped

macros.title: Apply a poison from one key
macros.desc: Coat your main hand with Instant Poison, or your off hand with Alt; put in the full name of the rank you carry, such as Instant Poison II.

keys.text: Instant Poison on your main hand
Deadly Poison instead of Instant Poison
Your off hand instead of your main hand

macros.needs: Poisons trained (Instant Poison at level 20, Deadly Poison at 30) and the poison in your bags

macros.title: Sharpen your weapons from one key
macros.desc: Put a Heavy Sharpening Stone on your main hand, or your off hand with Alt; Shift uses a Heavy Weightstone for blunt weapons.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Heavy Weightstone; Heavy Sharpening Stone
/use [mod:alt] 17; 16
/click StaticPopup1Button1

keys.text: Heavy Sharpening Stone on your main hand
Your off hand instead of your main hand

macros.needs: A stone in your bags (Heavy stones from level 15). In Forever a stone and a poison can share a weapon (Blizzard, 7 October)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Contrapeso Pesado; Pedra de Afiar Pesada
/use [mod:alt] 17; 16
/click StaticPopup1Button1

macros.title: Stealth out of combat, Vanish in it
macros.desc: Out of combat this puts you in Stealth; in combat it stops your swings and Vanishes so the next auto attack doesn't pull you out.
macros.needs: Vanish learned (level 22)

macros.title: Shank and auto attack
macros.desc: Stab with your off-hand weapon and keep swinging. Shank costs 5 Energy, gives 15 back and can't miss, on a 10 sec cooldown.
macros.needs: Shank learned (level 24); an off-hand weapon. Venom, Flash of Steel and Boot Knife each build on it

macros.title: Rupture and auto attack
macros.desc: Rupture your target and keep auto attack swinging.
macros.needs: Rupture learned (level 20); combo points

macros.title: Mutilate and auto attack
macros.desc: Mutilate and keep auto attack going in the same press.
macros.needs: Mutilate talent; daggers equipped

macros.title: One key for your finishers
macros.desc: Spend combo points on Eviscerate; the modifiers switch to Rupture or Expose Armor. Coordinate Expose Armor with the Warrior; Blizzard confirms Sunder Armor can still be used under stronger Expose Armor.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Rupture; [mod:ctrl] Expose Armor; Eviscerate
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Rupture; [mod:ctrl] Expose Armor; Eviscerate
macros.needs: Rupture learned (level 20); combo points
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Ruptura; [mod:ctrl] Expor Armadura; Eviscerar
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Ruptura; [mod:ctrl] Expor Armadura; Eviscerar

macros.title: Shank for Venom, else Mutilate
macros.desc: Shank whenever it's off cooldown, so Venom keeps your poisons hitting harder and landing more often, and Mutilate in between.
macros.needs: Venom and Mutilate talents; Shank learned (level 24); daggers equipped. Venom is a passive since 2 November

macros.title: Cold Blood into Eviscerate or Mutilate
macros.desc: Pop Cold Blood and strike in the same press; Cold Blood now covers Mutilate as well as Eviscerate.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Mutilate; Eviscerate
/cast Cold Blood
/cast [mod:shift] Mutilate; Eviscerate
macros.needs: Cold Blood and Mutilate talents; combo points for Eviscerate
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Mutilar; Eviscerar
/cast Sangue Frio
/cast [mod:shift] Mutilar; Eviscerar

macros.title: Ambush from Stealth, then Mutilate
macros.desc: Ambush while you're hidden and Mutilate once the fight is on; Shift swaps Mutilate for Backstab.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Ambush; [mod:shift] Backstab; Mutilate
/cast [stealth] Ambush; [mod:shift] Backstab; Mutilate
/startattack [nostealth]
macros.needs: Mutilate talent; a dagger in each hand; behind your target for Ambush and Backstab
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Emboscar; [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Mutilar
/cast [stealth] Emboscar; [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Mutilar
/startattack [nostealth]

macros.title: Sinister Strike, or Backstab with Shift
macros.desc: Build combo points with Sinister Strike, and hold Shift for Backstab when you're behind the target with a dagger in hand.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Backstab; Sinister Strike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Backstab; Sinister Strike
macros.needs: Backstab needs a dagger in your main hand and you behind the target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Golpe Sinistro
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Golpe Sinistro

macros.title: Garrote from Stealth, Rupture in the fight
macros.desc: Garrote while you're hidden; once the fight is on, the same key is Rupture with auto attack.
macros.needs: Garrote (level 14) and Rupture (level 20) learned; behind your target for Garrote unless you have Dirty Deeds; combo points for Rupture

macros.title: Three Mutilates, then Eviscerate
macros.desc: Press repeatedly: three Mutilates for a full set of points, then Eviscerate, then it starts over.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mutilate
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Mutilate, Mutilate, Mutilate, Eviscerate
macros.needs: Mutilate talent; daggers equipped. Each Mutilate gives 2 points, and a miss or dodge leaves Eviscerate a couple short
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Mutilar
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Mutilar, Mutilar, Mutilar, Eviscerar

macros.title: Mutilate, then Slice and Dice to start a long fight
macros.desc: Mutilate for two points and Slice and Dice on the next press; after that, go back to your normal keys.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mutilate
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Mutilate, Slice and Dice
macros.needs: Mutilate talent; daggers equipped; Slice and Dice learned (level 10)

macros.title: Riposte, then Sinister Strike
macros.desc: Riposte when a parry lights it, with Sinister Strike in the same press since Riposte is off the global cooldown; otherwise plain Sinister Strike.
macros.needs: Riposte talent; Riposte only works right after a parry

macros.title: Blade Flurry, Shift to cancel it
macros.desc: Start Blade Flurry and auto attack, or hold Shift to drop the buff when the extra strikes could hit a Sapped enemy.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Blade Flurry
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Blade Flurry
/startattack [nomod]
/cast [nomod] Blade Flurry
macros.needs: Blade Flurry talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rajada de Lâminas
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Rajada de Lâminas
/startattack [nomod]
/cast [nomod] Rajada de Lâminas

macros.title: Trinkets, Adrenaline Rush, then Blade Flurry
macros.desc: The first press uses your trinkets and Adrenaline Rush; press again within 20 seconds to add Blade Flurry.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Adrenaline Rush
/use 13
/use 14
/castsequence reset=20 Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry
macros.needs: Adrenaline Rush and Blade Flurry talents; on-use trinkets are optional
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Adrenalina
/use 13
/use 14
/castsequence reset=20 Adrenalina, Rajada de Lâminas

macros.title: Your core attacks on one key
macros.desc: Auto attack and Sinister Strike on a plain press, with the modifiers switching to your finishers and Feint.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Slice and Dice; [mod:ctrl] Eviscerate; [mod:alt] Feint; Sinister Strike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Slice and Dice; [mod:ctrl] Eviscerate; [mod:alt] Feint; Sinister Strike
macros.needs: Combo points for Slice and Dice and Eviscerate
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Retalhar; [mod:ctrl] Eviscerar; [mod:alt] Finta; Golpe Sinistro
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Retalhar; [mod:ctrl] Eviscerar; [mod:alt] Finta; Golpe Sinistro

macros.title: Garrote from Stealth, Sinister Strike after
macros.desc: Open with Garrote while you're hidden; from then on the same key is Sinister Strike with auto attack.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Garrote; Sinister Strike
/cast [stealth] Garrote; Sinister Strike
/startattack [nostealth]
macros.needs: Garrote learned (level 14); behind your target unless you have Dirty Deeds
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Garrote; Golpe Sinistro
/cast [stealth] Garrote; Golpe Sinistro
/startattack [nostealth]

macros.title: Backstab when you can, Sinister Strike when you can't
macros.desc: Backstab whenever you're behind the target with a dagger in hand; otherwise, or if you're short of its 60 Energy, the press is Sinister Strike.
macros.needs: A dagger in your main hand for Backstab (Puncturing Wounds makes it crit more for Combat)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Punhalada pelas Costas
/startattack [nostealth]
/cast Punhalada pelas Costas
/cast Golpe Sinistro

macros.title: Two Sinister Strikes, then Slice and Dice
macros.desc: Start a long fight by pressing this three times: two Sinister Strikes, then Slice and Dice.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Slice and Dice
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Sinister Strike, Sinister Strike, Slice and Dice
macros.needs: Slice and Dice learned (level 10)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Retalhar
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Golpe Sinistro, Golpe Sinistro, Retalhar

macros.title: Five Sinister Strikes, then Eviscerate
macros.desc: Press repeatedly on a mob you want dead fast: five Sinister Strikes, then Eviscerate, then it starts over.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Sinister Strike
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Sinister Strike, Sinister Strike, Sinister Strike, Sinister Strike, Sinister Strike, Eviscerate
macros.needs: A miss or dodge leaves Eviscerate a point short; better for grinding than for bosses
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Sinistro
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Golpe Sinistro, Golpe Sinistro, Golpe Sinistro, Golpe Sinistro, Golpe Sinistro, Eviscerar

macros.title: Slice and Dice, with a Frenzy Potion on Shift
macros.desc: Slice and Dice on a plain press; hold Shift to drink a Lesser Frenzy Potion first before a hard fight.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Slice and Dice
/use [mod:shift] Lesser Frenzy Potion
/cast Slice and Dice

keys.text: Lesser Frenzy Potion, then Slice and Dice

macros.needs: Lesser Frenzy Potion (level 15, new in Forever) in your bags; combo points for Slice and Dice
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Retalhar
/use [mod:shift] Poção Inferior de Frenesi
/cast Retalhar

macros.title: Equip your weapons for Sinister Strike
macros.desc: Replace both weapon names with yours. Swap back from your opening dagger to your chosen main hand and off hand, then Sinister Strike. Press again after the swap's global cooldown if needed.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Sinister Strike
/equipslot 16 Main-Hand Name
/equipslot 17 Off-Hand Name
/startattack
/cast Sinister Strike
macros.needs: The named weapons in your bags; Dual Wield for the off-hand
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Sinistro
/equipslot 16 Nome da Arma Principal
/equipslot 17 Nome da Arma Secundária
/startattack
/cast Golpe Sinistro

macros.title: Hemorrhage and auto attack
macros.desc: Hemorrhage and keep swinging; in Forever it boosts your own Rupture and Garrote instead of adding Physical damage.
macros.needs: Hemorrhage talent

macros.title: Cheap Shot from Stealth
macros.desc: Press once to enter Stealth and again to Cheap Shot your target.
macros.needs: Stealth and Cheap Shot learned

macros.title: Ambush after Ghostly Strike, else Backstab
macros.desc: Ambush from Stealth, or in the open within 7 sec of a Ghostly Strike; every other press is a Backstab.
macros.needs: Ghostly Strike talent for Ambush out of Stealth; a dagger in your main hand; behind your target

macros.title: Premeditation, Cheap Shot, then Kidney Shot
macros.desc: From Stealth this adds Premeditation's two points and Cheap Shot; press again once you're in the fight for Kidney Shot.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Cheap Shot; Kidney Shot
/cast [stealth] Premeditation
/cast [stealth] Cheap Shot; Kidney Shot
macros.needs: Premeditation talent (its window is 20 seconds in Forever, 10 in Classic); Kidney Shot learned (level 30)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Golpe Baixo; Golpe no Rim
/cast [stealth] Premeditação
/cast [stealth] Golpe Baixo; Golpe no Rim

macros.title: Target and Sap the nearest enemy
macros.desc: Stops your swings, picks the nearest enemy if you have no hostile target and Saps it; press again once you're in range.
macros.needs: Sap learned (level 10); a Humanoid that isn't in combat. Clear your target first if it's the wrong kind of enemy

macros.title: Ghostly Strike when ready, else Backstab
macros.desc: Ghostly Strike every time it comes off its 20 second cooldown and Backstab in between.
macros.needs: Ghostly Strike talent; a dagger in your main hand and a spot behind the target for Backstab
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe Fantasmagórico
/startattack [nostealth]
/cast Golpe Fantasmagórico
/cast Punhalada pelas Costas

macros.title: Hemorrhage, Rupture and Backstab on one key
macros.desc: One key for the Rupture loop: Hemorrhage on a plain press, Rupture with Shift and Backstab with Ctrl.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Rupture; [mod:ctrl] Backstab; Hemorrhage
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Rupture; [mod:ctrl] Backstab; Hemorrhage
macros.needs: Hemorrhage talent (it boosts your own Rupture and Garrote in Forever); Rupture learned (level 20); a dagger and a spot behind the target for Backstab
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Ruptura; [mod:ctrl] Punhalada pelas Costas; Hemorragia
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Ruptura; [mod:ctrl] Punhalada pelas Costas; Hemorragia

macros.title: Burn your escapes, then Preparation
macros.desc: Evasion and Sprint go off and Preparation resets them; hold Shift to Vanish and stop swinging instead of Evasion.
macros.needs: Preparation talent; Evasion and Sprint ready

macros.title: Pick Pocket, then Sap from Stealth
macros.desc: Pick the pocket of the enemy under your cursor (or your target) and Sap it in the same press.
macros.needs: Stealth; Sap learned (level 10); a Humanoid outside combat. Sap doesn't break Stealth (Blizzard, 7 October)

macros.title: Equip a dagger for Ambush or Backstab
macros.desc: Replace both weapon names with yours. Equip the dagger for Ambush, or Backstab with Shift. A combat weapon swap may need another press after the global cooldown.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Backstab; Ambush
/equipslot 16 Dagger Name
/equipslot 17 Off-Hand Name
/cast [mod:shift] Backstab; Ambush
/startattack [nostealth]

keys.text: Equip your dagger and attempt Ambush
Equip your dagger and attempt Backstab

macros.needs: Main-hand dagger; Dual Wield for the off-hand; behind the target; Stealth for Ambush
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Emboscar
/equipslot 16 Nome da Adaga
/equipslot 17 Nome da Arma Secundária
/cast [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Emboscar
/startattack [nostealth]

macros.title: Kick or Gouge on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Kick your target on a plain press; Shift moves it to your mouseover, and Ctrl or Alt swap in Gouge.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Gouge; Kick
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Kick; [mod:alt,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Gouge; [mod:ctrl] Gouge; Kick
macros.needs: Kick (level 12) and Gouge (level 6) learned; Gouge needs the target facing you
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Esfaquear; Chute
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Chute; [mod:alt,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Esfaquear; [mod:ctrl] Esfaquear; Chute

macros.title: Kick, then Gouge while Kick recharges
macros.desc: Kick on the first press and Gouge on the next while Kick is still on cooldown, against your mouseover or your target.
macros.needs: Kick and Gouge learned; Gouge needs the target facing you

macros.title: Cheap Shot from Stealth, Kidney Shot in the fight
macros.desc: Open with Cheap Shot while hidden and use Kidney Shot once the fight is on; Shift aims either one at your mouseover.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Cheap Shot; Kidney Shot
/cast [stealth,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Cheap Shot; [stealth] Cheap Shot; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Kidney Shot; Kidney Shot

keys.text: Cheap Shot from Stealth, otherwise Kidney Shot, on your target

macros.needs: Cheap Shot (level 26) and Kidney Shot (level 30) learned; Kidney Shot needs combo points
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Golpe Baixo; Golpe no Rim
/cast [stealth,mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Golpe Baixo; [stealth] Golpe Baixo; [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Golpe no Rim; Golpe no Rim

macros.title: Blind and Sap on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Blind your target, with Shift for your mouseover; Ctrl and Alt Sap the mouseover or the target instead.
macros.needs: Blind (level 34) with Blinding Powder in your bags; Sap needs a Humanoid outside combat and now flags you for PvP when it hits a flagged player (Blizzard, 24 September)

macros.title: Vanish and Sprint away
macros.desc: Stop swinging, Vanish and Sprint to break contact; Shift is Sprint alone and Ctrl is Evasion alone.
macros.needs: Vanish (level 22) and Sprint (level 10) ready; neither uses the global cooldown

macros.title: Dismount, Stealth and Sprint
macros.desc: Get off your mount, slip into Stealth and Sprint in one press to close the gap while hidden.
macros.needs: Out of combat for Stealth; the Sprint tooltip says it doesn't break Stealth

macros.title: Racial break, or a trinket with Shift or Ctrl
macros.desc: Press for the racial that shakes off an effect for your race; Shift and Ctrl use the top and bottom trinkets.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [nomod] Will to Survive
/cast [nomod] Will of the Forsaken
/cast [nomod] Escape Artist
/cast [nomod] Stoneform
/use [mod:shift] 13; [mod:ctrl] 14

keys.text: Your race's Will to Survive, Will of the Forsaken, Escape Artist or Stoneform

macros.needs: Human (Will to Survive removes stuns), Undead (Will of the Forsaken removes charm, fear and sleep), Gnome (Escape Artist breaks movement impairing effects) or Dwarf (Stoneform removes bleeds, poisons and diseases); on-use trinkets for Shift and Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [nomod] Desejo de Sobreviver
/cast [nomod] Determinação dos Renegados
/cast [nomod] Artista da Fuga
/cast [nomod] Forma de Pedra
/use [mod:shift] 13; [mod:ctrl] 14

macros.title: Free Action Potion and Sprint
macros.desc: Drink a Free Action Potion and Sprint before you're caught; Shift drinks a Swiftness Potion on its own instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Swiftness Potion; Free Action Potion
/use [mod:shift] Swiftness Potion; Free Action Potion
/cast [nomod] Sprint
macros.needs: Free Action Potion (level 20) or Swiftness Potion in your bags; Free Action doesn't remove effects already on you
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Poção de Rapidez; Poção de Ação Desimpedida
/use [mod:shift] Poção de Rapidez; Poção de Ação Desimpedida
/cast [nomod] Disparada

macros.title: Throw at your target or mouseover
macros.desc: Throw a weapon at your target, or at whoever is under your cursor with Shift.
macros.needs: A thrown weapon in your ranged slot

macros.title: Poisons for fighting players
macros.desc: Crippling Poison on a plain press, Wound Poison with Shift for healers and Mind-numbing Poison with Ctrl for casters; Alt picks the off hand.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Wound Poison; [mod:ctrl] Mind-numbing Poison; Crippling Poison
/use [mod:alt] 17; 16
/click StaticPopup1Button1

keys.text: Crippling Poison on your main hand
Your off hand instead of your main hand

macros.needs: Crippling Poison (level 20), Mind-numbing Poison (24) and Wound Poison (32) trained and in your bags; use each poison's exact rank name
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/use [mod:shift] Veneno Ferino; [mod:ctrl] Veneno Entorpecente; Veneno Debilitante
/use [mod:alt] 17; 16
/click StaticPopup1Button1

macros.title: Kidney Shot, then Blind
macros.desc: Kidney Shot on the first press; press again as the stun runs out to Blind the same target. It stops auto attack on each press so a stray swing can't break Blind.
macros.needs: Kidney Shot (level 30) with combo points; Blind (level 34) with Blinding Powder in your bags. Changing target starts it over at Kidney Shot

macros.title: Blind, then bandage yourself
macros.desc: Stop swinging and Blind your target, then hold Shift to bandage yourself while they wander. Swap in the bandage you actually carry.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Heavy Runecloth Bandage; Blind
/stopattack [nomod]
/cast [nomod] Blind
/use [mod:shift,@player] Heavy Runecloth Bandage

keys.text: Stop attacking and Blind your target

macros.needs: Blind (level 34) with Blinding Powder; First Aid and the bandage in your bags. Any damage ends Blind early, and getting hit stops the bandage
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Bandagem Grossa de Runatrama; Cegar
/stopattack [nomod]
/cast [nomod] Cegar
/use [mod:shift,@player] Bandagem Grossa de Runatrama

macros.title: Vanish, then Sap
macros.desc: In a fight this stops your swings and Vanishes; press again while hidden to Sap your mouseover or target. Out of combat the first press is plain Stealth.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Sap; [combat] Vanish; Stealth
/stopattack
/cast [nostealth,combat] Vanish; [nostealth] Stealth; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Sap
macros.needs: Vanish (level 22) and Sap learned. Sap only lands once the enemy drops out of combat, so your bleeds and poisons on them get in the way. Sap no longer breaks Stealth (Blizzard, 7 October)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Aturdir; [combat] Sumir; Furtividade
/stopattack
/cast [nostealth,combat] Sumir; [nostealth] Furtividade; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Aturdir

macros.title: Gouge, then Vanish
macros.desc: Gouge on the first press, then press again while they stand there to Vanish and get back into Stealth for a fresh opener.
macros.needs: Gouge (level 6) and Vanish (level 22) learned; Gouge needs the target facing you. Improved Gouge, an Assassination talent in Forever, adds up to 1.5 sec

macros.title: Burst window: trinkets, Cold Blood and racial
macros.desc: Fire both trinkets, Cold Blood and your Orc or Troll racial together, then follow with your biggest attack.
macros.needs: Cold Blood talent (level 25); on-use trinkets; Blood Fury (Orc) or Berserking (Troll), which both changed in Forever. Anything you don't have is skipped

macros.title: Cold Blood into Ambush or Backstab
macros.desc: Cold Blood, then Ambush from Stealth for a 100% crit chance opener; hold Shift for Backstab when you're already visible.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Backstab; Ambush
/cast Cold Blood
/cast [mod:shift] Backstab; Ambush
macros.needs: Cold Blood talent (level 25); a dagger in your main hand; behind your target
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Emboscar
/cast Sangue Frio
/cast [mod:shift] Punhalada pelas Costas; Emboscar

macros.title: Cheap Shot from Stealth, Mutilate after
macros.desc: Open with Cheap Shot while hidden; after that the same key is Mutilate with auto attack for the rest of the stun. Shift opens with Garrote instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth,mod:shift] Garrote; [stealth] Cheap Shot; Mutilate
/cast [stealth,mod:shift] Garrote; [stealth] Cheap Shot; Mutilate
/startattack [nostealth]

keys.text: Cheap Shot from Stealth, otherwise Mutilate
Garrote from Stealth instead of Cheap Shot

macros.needs: Mutilate talent and a dagger in each hand; Cheap Shot learned (level 26); behind your target for Garrote
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth,mod:shift] Garrote; [stealth] Golpe Baixo; Mutilar
/cast [stealth,mod:shift] Garrote; [stealth] Golpe Baixo; Mutilar
/startattack [nostealth]

macros.title: Two Mutilates, then Kidney Shot
macros.desc: Press repeatedly: two Mutilates for four or more points, then Kidney Shot, then it starts over. Improved Kidney Shot makes your attacks and poisons hit harder during the stun.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mutilate
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Mutilate, Mutilate, Kidney Shot
macros.needs: Mutilate talent; daggers equipped; Kidney Shot learned (level 30). A miss or dodge leaves the stun shorter. Improved Kidney Shot is optional
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Mutilar
/startattack
/castsequence reset=8/target Mutilar, Mutilar, Golpe no Rim

macros.title: Kidney Shot, then a Cold Blood Mutilate in the stun
macros.desc: The first press pops Cold Blood and Kidney Shots your target. Kidney Shot doesn't use up Cold Blood, so the next press is a Mutilate with the extra crit chance.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Kidney Shot
/cast Cold Blood
/castsequence reset=8/target Kidney Shot, Mutilate
macros.needs: Cold Blood and Mutilate talents; daggers equipped; Kidney Shot (level 30) and combo points. Cold Blood goes off even if Kidney Shot fails, so press it with points ready
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe no Rim
/cast Sangue Frio
/castsequence reset=8/target Golpe no Rim, Mutilar

macros.title: Kidney Shot with trinkets and racial
macros.desc: Kidney Shot, both trinkets and your Orc or Troll racial in one press, so your damage cooldowns run while Improved Kidney Shot has them taking extra damage.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Kidney Shot
/cast Kidney Shot
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Blood Fury
/cast Berserking
macros.needs: Kidney Shot (level 30) and combo points; Improved Kidney Shot talent; on-use trinkets; Blood Fury (Orc) or Berserking (Troll). Anything you don't have is skipped, and the trinkets fire even if Kidney Shot doesn't
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Golpe no Rim
/cast Golpe no Rim
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast Berserk

macros.title: Cheap Shot, Gouge, then Kidney Shot
macros.desc: Cheap Shot from Stealth and build points during the stun; press again as it ends for Gouge, hold off while they're Gouged, then press once more for Kidney Shot.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=12/target Cheap Shot, Gouge, Kidney Shot
macros.needs: Cheap Shot (level 26) and Kidney Shot (level 30) learned; start in Stealth; Gouge needs them facing you. Improved Gouge and Improved Kidney Shot, both Assassination talents in Forever, make Gouge last longer and Kidney Shot hurt more
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=12/target Golpe Baixo, Esfaquear, Golpe no Rim

macros.title: Eviscerate, Kidney Shot or Shank for Venom
macros.desc: Eviscerate on a plain press, Kidney Shot with Shift when you need the stun, and Shank with Ctrl so Venom makes your Crippling or Mind-numbing Poison land more often.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Kidney Shot; [mod:ctrl] Shank; Eviscerate
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Kidney Shot; [mod:ctrl] Shank; Eviscerate
macros.needs: Venom talent; Shank (level 24) and Kidney Shot (level 30) learned; combo points for the finishers
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Golpe no Rim; [mod:ctrl] Estocar; Eviscerar
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Golpe no Rim; [mod:ctrl] Estocar; Eviscerar

macros.title: Riposte, then Eviscerate or Kidney Shot
macros.desc: Tries Riposte, which only goes off right after a parry, then casts your finisher in the same press: Eviscerate, or Kidney Shot with Shift.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Kidney Shot; Eviscerate
/startattack
/cast Riposte
/cast [mod:shift] Kidney Shot; Eviscerate

keys.text: Riposte if a parry lit it, then Eviscerate
Riposte if a parry lit it, then Kidney Shot

macros.needs: Riposte talent; Riposte is off the global cooldown. Kidney Shot learned (level 30); combo points
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Golpe no Rim; Eviscerar
/startattack
/cast Ripostar
/cast [mod:shift] Golpe no Rim; Eviscerar

macros.title: Riposte the enemy under your cursor
macros.desc: After a parry, Riposte and disarm the Warrior or Rogue under your cursor while you stay on your own target. With nothing under the cursor it hits your target.
macros.needs: Riposte talent; it only works right after a parry. The disarm lasts 6 sec

macros.title: Kick, with Sprint on Shift to reach the caster
macros.desc: Kick your mouseover or target. Hold Shift to Sprint first, which with Improved Sprint pulls you out of roots and snares; press again once you're in range to Kick.

keys.text: Sprint, then Kick if you're already in range

macros.needs: Kick learned (level 12); Improved Sprint talent to clear roots and snares; Improved Kick adds a 2 sec silence

macros.title: Kick, then Kidney Shot
macros.desc: Kick on the first press and Kidney Shot on the next, so a healer goes straight from the interrupt into a stun. Improved Kick's silence stops them casting anything in between.
macros.needs: Kick (level 12) and Kidney Shot (level 30) learned; combo points for Kidney Shot. Improved Kick talent for the 2 sec silence

macros.title: Gouge, then Backstab from behind
macros.desc: Gouge on the first press, step behind them while they stand still, then press again for Backstab.
macros.needs: A dagger in your main hand; Gouge needs them facing you. Puncturing Wounds gives Backstab more crit and a chance at an extra combo point

macros.title: Gouge and Sprint away
macros.desc: Sprint and Gouge your target in the same press to get out of a fight you're losing. With Improved Sprint it also clears Hamstring and other snares.
macros.needs: Sprint ready (it's off the global cooldown); Gouge needs the target facing you. Improved Sprint talent to clear snares

macros.title: Adrenaline Rush, trinkets and racial, no Blade Flurry
macros.desc: Adrenaline Rush, both trinkets and your Orc or Troll racial in one press. Blade Flurry stays off, so it won't break a Sap, Blind or Gouge on someone next to you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Adrenaline Rush
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Adrenaline Rush
/cast Blood Fury
/cast Berserking
macros.needs: Adrenaline Rush talent; on-use trinkets; Blood Fury (Orc) or Berserking (Troll). Anything you don't have is skipped

macros.title: Premeditation with Garrote or Ambush
macros.desc: From Stealth, adds Premeditation's two points and opens with Garrote; hold Shift to open with Ambush instead.
macros.needs: Premeditation talent; Stealth. Garrote needs you behind the target unless you have Dirty Deeds; Ambush needs a main-hand dagger and you behind

macros.title: Vanish, then Premeditation and Cheap Shot
macros.desc: In a fight the first press stops your swings and Vanishes; the next press, while you're hidden, adds Premeditation and opens again with Cheap Shot.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [stealth] Cheap Shot; [combat] Vanish; Stealth
/stopattack [nostealth]
/cast [nostealth,combat] Vanish; [nostealth] Stealth
/cast [stealth] Premeditation
/cast [stealth] Cheap Shot
macros.needs: Vanish (level 22) and Cheap Shot (level 26) learned; Premeditation talent. Out of combat the first press is plain Stealth
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [stealth] Golpe Baixo; [combat] Sumir; Furtividade
/stopattack [nostealth]
/cast [nostealth,combat] Sumir; [nostealth] Furtividade
/cast [stealth] Premeditação
/cast [stealth] Golpe Baixo

macros.title: Sap one enemy, then open on another
macros.desc: Hold Shift to Sap the enemy under your cursor, then let go and press again to open on your target with Premeditation and Cheap Shot. Sap no longer breaks Stealth in Forever.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Sap; Cheap Shot
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Sap
/cast [nomod,stealth] Premeditation
/cast [nomod,stealth] Cheap Shot

keys.text: Premeditation and Cheap Shot on your target
Sap your mouseover, or your target with nothing under the cursor

macros.needs: Sap and Cheap Shot (level 26) learned; Premeditation talent; the Sapped enemy has to be a Humanoid out of combat. Dirty Tricks and Dirty Deeds cut the Energy for both
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Aturdir; Golpe Baixo
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Aturdir
/cast [nomod,stealth] Premeditação
/cast [nomod,stealth] Golpe Baixo

macros.title: Evasion and Ghostly Strike together
macros.desc: When a Warrior or Rogue is on you, one press stacks Evasion's dodge with Ghostly Strike's. With Setup, attacks you dodge from your target can add a combo point.
macros.needs: Ghostly Strike talent; Evasion ready (it's off the global cooldown). Setup is optional

macros.title: Ghostly Strike, else Hemorrhage
macros.desc: Ghostly Strike goes first; when it can't be cast, because it's cooling down or you're short of its 40 Energy, the same press falls through to Hemorrhage.
macros.needs: Ghostly Strike and Hemorrhage talents

macros.title: Backstab from behind, Hemorrhage from the front
macros.desc: Backstab goes first; when you're not behind them or are short of its 60 Energy, the same press falls through to Hemorrhage. Handy when a player keeps turning to face you.
macros.needs: Hemorrhage talent; a dagger in your main hand, which in Forever also raises Hemorrhage's damage
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Punhalada pelas Costas
/startattack
/cast Punhalada pelas Costas
/cast Hemorragia

macros.title: Blind, and Preparation for a second Blind
macros.desc: Stop swinging and Blind your target. Hold Ctrl for Preparation, which finishes Blind's cooldown along with your other Rogue cooldowns, so you can Blind a second enemy.

keys.text: Stop attacking and Blind your target

macros.needs: Blind (level 34) with Blinding Powder; Preparation talent (10 min cooldown). Its tooltip says it finishes the cooldown on all your other Rogue abilities; we haven't seen that on Blind in play yet. Elusiveness also shortens Blind's cooldown
